sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Lab 1: the GAN Minimax and Mode Collapse Studio! Switch between Vanilla Minimax, Non-Saturating loss, and WGAN-GP Lipschitz training. Step epochs across the 4-mode target manifold, trigger mode collapse, and monitor critic vector fields, convergence losses, and empirical mode coverage!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Look at those four live canvases directly below us, Dr. Nova! When we trigger collapse in Vanilla Minimax, every particle crowds onto Mode 1 while the Lipschitz norm spikes to 4.8—yet switching to WGAN-GP spreads all four modes evenly again!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 1: Under Goodfellow's 2014 minimax theorem, when the generator achieves perfect distribution matching p g equals p data, determine the optimal discriminator score D star of x and evaluate the minimax objective V(D star, G). Select Option A, B, C, or D!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: First checkpoint! If generator distribution p g matches p data everywhere, what does D star output, and what exact numerical value does V(D star, G) reach at Nash equilibrium? Lock in your answer above us!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Outstanding proof! When p g equals p data, D star equals p data over 2 p data, or exactly one-half! Substituting D star equals 0.5 into V yields log of 0.5 plus log of 0.5, which equals minus log 4, or approximately minus 1.3863!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Remember D star of x equals p data over p data plus p g. At optimal convergence p g equals p data, this simplifies to 0.50! Plugging 0.50 into expected log D plus expected log 1 minus D gives minus log 2 minus log 2 equals minus log 4, or minus 1.3863!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Lab 2: the Gradient Saturation and CTGAN VGM Explorer! Sweep critic logit separation s to compare vanishing Vanilla Minimax gradients against Non-Saturating and WGAN-GP signals, and inspect how Variational Gaussian Mixture normalization captures sharp multimodal peaks!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Look at the left gradient plot when logit margin drops to minus 6, Nova! Vanilla Minimax flattens to zero while Non-Saturating holds strong—and on the right plot, CTGAN VGM splits sharp price modes cleanly instead of blurring them together!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 2: Why does CTGAN represent continuous tabular features using a 10-component Variational Gaussian Mixture Model with one-hot mode vector b and normalized scalar v instead of standard min-max scaling? Select Option A, B, C, or D!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Second checkpoint! Why do continuous transaction amounts blur under standard GAN tanh outputs, and how does CTGAN's VGM decomposition eliminate multimodal mode collapse? Select your diagnosis above me!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Correct! Backpropagation averages gradients across sharp multimodal peaks in standard GANs, smearing them into a wide single hump. Fitting a 10-component VGM lets the generator output a discrete mode via Gumbel-Softmax paired with a localized intra-mode scalar v, preserving razor-sharp peaks!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Standard continuous generators average opposing gradients across distinct multimodal peaks, causing blur and mode collapse. CTGAN's VGM decomposes continuous features into a discrete one-hot component b and normalized intra-mode scalar v equals c minus mu k over 4 sigma k!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 3: A Vanilla Minimax GAN stalls with zero gradients on 256-cubed 3D MRI scans while blurring multimodal payment streams. Which mathematical diagnosis and architectural fix resolves both defects? Choose Option A, B, C, or D!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Final checkpoint! Why did Vanilla Minimax freeze on 3D volumetric scans and smear multimodal transaction records, and what cures both failures? Lock in your answer above us!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Outstanding mastery! Disjoint high-dimensional supports lock Jensen-Shannon divergence at constant log 2 with zero gradients; WGAN-GP enforces 1-Lipschitz continuity along straight interpolations for smooth volumetric drift, while CTGAN's VGM mode encoding and conditional oversampling solve multimodal tabular skew!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Weight clipping cripples critic capacity and Vanilla BCE freezes at log 2 under disjoint 3D supports. You need WGAN-GP with lambda gp equals 10 for continuous 1-Lipschitz gradients alongside CTGAN VGM mode-specific normalization for multimodal tabular columns!
